evidence_items.summary: AOS-Bench Trajectories Agent trajectories behind the paper AOS-Bench: Can LLM Agents Manage Dynamic Workloads? Paper: arXiv:2610.33178 · Code: https://github.com/AOS-Bench/AOS-Bench The release has 1,774 trials, the ones the paper's results use that pass its full-clean filter. A trial is kept when it has a reward record, a transcript and at least 8 trajectory steps, and shows no output-cap, throttling, unavailable-route or verifier-download failure.
